reviewerFeedback:
your previous preferred design was rated acceptable: The four price columns are balanced and keep the comma-separated amounts intact, making year-to-year comparisons possible. Apartment names wrap heavily, and the last area value splits within its digits. | another layout was rated poor: Several price amounts split within their digits, making comparisons harder. Apartment names also wrap heavily, although the area values remain intact. | another layout was rated poor: Price amounts stay intact and the year groups are balanced, but the apartment-name column is so narrow that names read almost one character per line, obscuring the row labels and creating very tall rows. | another layout was rated bad: Many prices and area values split within their digits, while apartment names still wrap heavily. The broken numbers make the table difficult to scan reliably.
